definitions.explanation: The point at which something begins. Noun form of the verb {始|はじ}まる (to begin). Can refer to the start of events, stories, relationships, or abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{始|はじ}まり。
⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{始|はじ}まり⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is the beginning of the story.

examples.japanese: {始|はじ}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Everything that has a beginning has an end.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{始|はじ}まりだった。
examples.english: That was the beginning of their friendship.

examples.japanese: {始|はじ}まり⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧、⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧だった。
examples.english: I watched the whole thing from beginning to end, but the most interesting part was the final scene.

notes:
Noun form of the intransitive verb ⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ (to begin). Compare with ⟦{始|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧, which often means 'the beginning' as a point in time or 'at first.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{始|はじ}まり (beginning of a story)
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{始|はじ}まり (new beginning)
- ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{始|はじ}まり (the beginning of everything)
- {始|はじ}まり⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (from start to finish)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{始|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧ - beginning, first (often temporal: ⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ = at first)
- ⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ - to begin (intransitive verb)
- ⟦{始|はじ}める→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧ - to start (transitive verb)
